incidents.name: OKC miner pool LP spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: The OKC miner pool valued staked USDT/OKC LP from the pair's live reserves, which the attacker skewed with chained DODO and PancakeV3 flash loans before staking and redeeming.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x36016C4F0E0177861E6377f73C380c70138E13EE created 2023-11-13T14:16:26Z by 0xd1ec464ba8e02391c2491ccc9b63d4f60cdc9e5a, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xbbcc139933d1580e7c40442e09263e90e6f1d66d; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). Loss taken from the exploit transaction itself: the attacker EOA nets 6,268.10 USDT of ERC-20 Transfer flow in this tx.
